CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations), an explicit presentation/organization origin, and a separate status/origin attribution are all present for the same candidate record.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition to a specific content's organization or access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labeled cell sets) with location attribute are listed.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from the identified content for the same candidate record, distinguishing identity from presentation/status.

O.rationale: Statements describe how content is presented (layout rules) and include explicit origin/presentation tags for candidate/current records.
